references.text: Basic instruction to bring skin diseases to the priest for examination, establishing the priest's role in assessing purity
Another case where the priest declares a person clean (טָהוֹר) after examining the condition of the skin
The priest examines and declares the person clean when white appears on the skin, similar to the assessment of white spots
The immediately preceding verse describing white spots (בֶּהָרֹת) on the skin that the priest is to examine
Summary of the laws concerning various skin diseases, including בֹּהַק (a harmless skin rash), to determine purity and impurity
